# Work smarter in 90 days: A real-world guide to using AI

Microsoft AI has published a new guide titled "Work smarter in 90 days: A real-world guide to using AI." This guide offers practical strategies for integrating artificial intelligence into daily life and routines. It highlights using AI voice assistants to manage hands-free tasks, such as setting reminders or accessing information without direct device interaction. The resource aims to help users enhance efficiency and address common inconveniences through accessible AI applications.

## What this means for you

This guide helps you discover simple ways to use AI to manage daily tasks more efficiently. You can learn to leverage AI voice assistants for hands-free support, like setting reminders or organizing lists while busy. It provides actionable insights to apply AI technologies in your everyday life.
